{"subject":"Congrats on Pulley's $41M Series B","body":"Hi Andreas,

Congratulations on Pulley's $41M Series B four days ago. With a round that size, the board will likely expect a forecast, and I saw you're hiring an Enterprise SDR Manager and two Enterprise Account Executives.

Quillpath reads your CRM every night and flags stalled deals. It also gives each rep a short list of next actions and writes a weekly pipeline and forecast summary you can forward to the board. It connects read-only to HubSpot or Salesforce in about 15 minutes, with nothing to migrate.

Would you like to run the free 14-day pilot on Pulley's real pipeline before the new sellers start?","missing":["Which CRM Pulley uses (HubSpot or Salesforce is not stated in the evidence)","Whether Pulley has a dedicated RevOps person or who runs sales today"]}
